Each page develops one connected family of ideas, with sections for concepts best understood together.
Substantial supporting topics have their own linked pages.
Definitions and main results stay visible; expand a derivation or proof for the supporting steps.
Notes explain the motivation, what kind of object the concept is, how it works, and where it applies or breaks down.
Hover over, focus on, or tap a pastel-highlighted term for a short supporting definition.

| Subject | Scope |
|---|---|
| [Mathematics](mathematics/index.qmd) | Probability, information, estimation, optimization, and matrix methods. |
| [Machine Learning](machine-learning/index.qmd) | Models, representations, objectives, and learning procedures. |
| [Robotics](robotics/index.qmd) | Robot policies, action coordinates, sampling, and feedback during execution. |
| [Physics](physics/index.qmd) | Physical systems, circuits, electronics, signals, and control. |
| [Computer Hardware](computer-hardware/index.qmd) | Digital logic, processors, memory, and computer architecture. |
| [Computer Software](computer-software/index.qmd) | Programming, algorithms, systems, and computational operations. |
